title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-07
source: source: aud reel master; taped by Marty Weinberg; akg d190e > uher 4000L; transferred by Michael Parish; seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Miraculous upgrade turns a muddy, bass‑buzzed recording into an excellent capture of a scorching Good Lovin’ performance
ai_review.review: The reviewer hails this newly upgraded tape as a “miracle,” turning what was once a mud‑filled, bass‑buzz mess into a crystal‑clear, high‑energy version. The highlight is the blistering rendition of Good Lovin’, which they rank among the best pre‑1971 performances, and the improvement in sound quality makes it worth revisiting the entire show.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (especially Good Lovin’) and a dramatic jump in recording quality, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original tape described as muddy with bass buzz; the new version is called a 'miracle' and markedly clearer, with no lingering mention of distortion or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not discussed; focus was on the overall fire of Good Lovin’ and the upgrade's impact on listening experience.
